findings.title: No concrete in-repository TS/Python process runner registration is present
evidence: internal/analysis/providers/process.go:NewProcessAdapter defines an adapter that accepts ports.LanguageProviderProcess
rg over internal Go sources found NewProcessAdapter callsites only in process_test.go; no production runner implementation or registration callsite was found
findings.impact: The standalone TS/Python CLI packages and their passing local suites do not prove that the engine can invoke those providers in a normal runtime path.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicitly scoped integration task that supplies the approved host process runner, registers the providers, and verifies an end-to-end engine request/response against isolated fixtures before claiming runtime capability.
findings.boundary: This is an in-repository source finding; it does not rule out an external host integration that is not present in this checkout.
